name: Image
text: The Image module provides a class with the same name which is used to represent a PIL image.

name: ImageChops
text: The ImageChops module contains a number of arithmetical image operations, called channel operations (“chops”).

name: ImageCms
text: The ImageCms module provides color profile management support using the LittleCMS2 color management engine, based on Kevin Cazabon's PyCMS library.

name: ImageColor
text: The ImageColor module contains color tables and converters from CSS3-style color specifiers to RGB tuples.

name: ImageDraw
text: The ImageDraw module provides simple 2D graphics for PIL.Image.Image objects.

name: ImageEnhance
text: The ImageEnhance module contains a number of classes that can be used for image enhancement.

name: ImageFile
text: The ImageFile module provides support functions for the image open and save functions.

name: ImageFilter
text: The ImageFilter module contains definitions for a pre-defined set of filters, which can be used with the Image.filter() method.

name: CSV Auto Detection
text: When using read_csv, the system tries to automatically infer how to read the CSV file using the CSV sniffer.

name: Reading Faulty CSV Files
text: CSV files can come in all shapes and forms, with some presenting many errors that make the process of cleanly reading them inherently difficult.

name: CSV Import Tips
text: Below is a collection of tips to help when attempting to import complex CSV files.

name: SELECT Clause
text: The SELECT clause specifies the list of columns that will be returned by the query.

name: FROM and JOIN Clauses
text: The FROM clause specifies the source of the data on which the remainder of the query should operate.

name: WHERE Clause
text: The WHERE clause specifies any filters to apply to the data.

name: GROUP BY Clause
text: The GROUP BY clause specifies which grouping columns should be used to perform any aggregations in the SELECT clause.

name: CSS Images Module Level 3
text: This module contains the features of CSS level 3 relating to the <image> type and some replaced elements.

name: CSS Display Module Level 3
text: This module describes how the CSS formatting box tree is generated from the document element tree and defines the display property that controls it.

name: Metadata Vocabulary for Tabular Data
text: Validation, conversion, display, and search of tabular data on the web requires additional metadata that describes how the data should be interpreted.
